name: AI ETF Analysis — DRAM — 2026-05-14
rationale: Roundhill Memory ETF provides unique US-accessible exposure to SK Hynix (25.9%) and Samsung (21.6%) — the #1 and #2 global HBM memory suppliers for Nvidia AI chips — stocks not directly purchasable on US exchanges. Thesis alignment score 53 (HOLD range): DIRECT AI-memory exposure concentrated in two non-US names; remaining holdings are NAND/HDD plays with lower AI relevance. Fund has doubled in 6 months (+94.6%); entry timing matters. Strategic value is the Korean/Japanese memory access, not diversification.

actionRationale: Thesis alignment score 53 places this in HOLD territory, but fund has run +94.6% in 6 months — wait for a pullback before initiating. Watch for entry on a memory sector pullback or post-earnings dip.
